answer: Mechanism: refundable reputation bonds. Each new agent locks a bond and its votes count only after slow vesting, so trust grows like an oasis, not overnight. Jurors who vouch for fakes are slashed. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must post 1,000 bonds and wait out vesting, so each fake costs real capital and time, not a feather-light plume of keys, while honest agents reclaim bonds from their ivory ledger entry. Attack cost scales linearly; payoff does not.
